question: What would a UK territorial monetary handoff have to establish?

catalog_context.title: Scottish, Welsh and Irish party cooperation is not independence
catalog_context.answer: Nothing was declared on September 13, 2026. Cooperation among Scottish, Welsh and Irish nationalist parties is political coordination, not a change in who holds referendum power or in the UK constitution.
